title: IoT architecture

spans.text: LESSON PURPOSE

Goal: apply “IoT architecture” to a real program or device. The key principle is: Devices measure, communication transports data, and services consume it. In a project, follow this guidance: A gateway is not mandatory in every deployment; choose architecture for the actual network.
QUESTION: What will this example do? Predict the result first.

EXPECTED RESULT
No program output; this lesson models device, network, service, and application layers.
CORE EXPLANATION
A typical system has devices, a network, gateways, and services/apps. Define identity, data formats, failure behavior, and update ownership at each boundary.
IMPORTANT LINE BREAKDOWN

What it does: Devices measure, communication transports data, and services consume it.
Why it is used: A gateway is not mandatory in every deployment; choose architecture for the actual network.
